definitions.independent_unit: training seed; contexts and phases summarized within seed
definitions.uncertainty: unadjusted descriptive95%tintervals across all available training seeds; no primary tests
definitions.normal_return: distance to time-matched full-state curve divided by initial distance; return=1-remaining
definitions.tangent_retention: median of per-phase decoded displacement ratios, then mean across stated contexts
definitions.perturbation_times: 1/5seconds after perturbing the state prepared by2seconds blank input
definitions.blank_memory_times: 2/7/32seconds total blank input after initial cue
definitions.spectra: median over phases, then mean within specified context group; slow mode closest to+1
definitions.untrained_output_caution: untrained readout is also random; heading accuracy alone does not diagnose hidden memory
definitions.undefined_values: not imputed; model retained, unavailable metric and denominator explicitly reported
